dataset_name: Stratosphere CTU-13 / Malware Capture Facility (real-world sample)
_provenance: Captures from https://mcfp.felk.cvut.cz/publicDatasets/ (Stratosphere IPS, CTU University). botnet-capture-* = a host infected with real malware (label: malicious); normal-capture-* / *-only-dns = real benign traffic (label: benign). Download with datasets/fetch_ctu.sh. PCAPs are gitignored (large + malware). expect[] lists the ground-truth behaviour the malware family exhibits (C2 communication) for the per-detector recall breakdown; it is honestly reported as a miss when PacketIQ's heuristics do not catch it.
